title: AI Vision Mission Extraction
description: Schema for structured JSON returned by an AI vision assistant after analyzing Star Citizen mission contract screenshots.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. AI output is never authoritative.

source_class.description: Fixed class identifier for AI vision output.

extraction_confidence.description: AI's self-reported confidence in the extraction (0.0-1.0), or UNRESOLVED.

patch_version.description: Patch version visible in the screenshot, or UNRESOLVED.

ship.description: Ship name if visible or supplied by the user, or UNRESOLVED.

missions.description: One entry per mission contract visible in the screenshot.

issuer.description: Mission issuer name exactly as shown, or UNRESOLVED.

pickup.description: Pick-up location exactly as shown, or UNRESOLVED.

delivery.description: Delivery location(s) exactly as shown, or UNRESOLVED.

cargo_scu.description: Cargo quantity in SCU exactly as shown. UNRESOLVED if not visible.

reward_usc.description: Contract reward in aUEC exactly as shown. UNRESOLVED if not visible.

fee_usc.description: Any fees shown in aUEC exactly as shown. UNRESOLVED if not visible.

timer_minutes.description: Contract timer in minutes, or UNRESOLVED.

contract_type.description: Contract category if visible (e.g. cargo_hauling), or UNRESOLVED.

unresolved_fields.description: List of field names the AI could not extract from the screenshot.

notes.description: Any extraction caveats. Must NOT contain fabricated data.

unresolved_fields.description: Fields that could not be extracted from the screenshot at the batch level.

session_notes.description: Any overall extraction notes. Must NOT contain fabricated data.
